tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Construction projects the caller can see: id, name, location, status. Omit `query` to list them all in name order (up to `limit`); give part of a name to find one. Call it first when you need a project_id. Retail projects are not included.

query.description: Substring to match against project name. Case-insensitive. Omit or leave empty to list every project you can see.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: get_project_details
tools.description: One project's details: name, location, dates, budget, status, and counts of phases, contracts and milestones. Use for "tell me about project X" or a status overview. For money questions use `get_project_financial_summary`.

project_id.description: The project UUID, typically obtained from `search_projects`.

tools.name: list_project_phases
tools.description: A project's phases (time divisions such as Faza 1, Faza 2) in order, with dates, status and `budget_allocated`. Use when the user asks about phases. Not for cost categories (use `list_cost_classifications` and `list_contracts`) or spend (use `get_project_financial_summary`).

project_id.description: The project UUID whose phases to list.

tools.name: search_subcontractors
tools.description: Subcontractors (izvođači, the construction-side suppliers) by name: id, name, contact, active_contracts_count. Call it when the user names a subcontractor and you need its subcontractor_id for another tool.

query.description: Substring to match against subcontractor name. Case-insensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: list_cost_classifications
tools.description: The cost classifications (stavke troškovnika: Zemljište, Priprema i razvoj, Izgradnja i uređenje…) with their ids. Call it to turn a cost category the user named into a classification_id for `list_contracts`.

include_inactive.description: Include deactivated classifications. Defaults to false.

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: Construction contracts, filtered by project, phase, cost classification, subcontractor or status: amounts, `budget_realized` (the authoritative spend), dates, status. Use for contract questions, and for spend on a cost category (filter by classification_id, not by phase).

project_id.description: Filter to contracts on this project.

phase_id.description: Filter to contracts on this phase (a time division, not a cost category).

classification_id.description: Filter to contracts in this cost classification. This is the right filter for "spend on land", "spend on preparation", etc.

subcontractor_id.description: Filter to contracts with this subcontractor.

status.description: Filter by contract status. Note: lowercase values, distinct from project/invoice status casing.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: get_subcontractor_payment_status
tools.description: One subcontractor's totals: contracted, invoiced, paid and still owed. Use for "is X paid up?" or "how much do we still owe X?". For the individual payments use `list_payments_for_subcontractor`. Construction only, not retail.

subcontractor_id.description: The subcontractor UUID, typically obtained from `search_subcontractors`.

tools.name: list_unpaid_invoices
tools.description: Invoices still UNPAID or PARTIALLY_PAID, optionally for one subcontractor or project, earliest due date first. Use for "what do we still owe?" or overdue invoices. For counts and totals across all invoices use `get_invoice_summary`.

subcontractor_id.description: Filter to invoices for this subcontractor (via supplier_id).

project_id.description: Filter to invoices for this project.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: list_payments_for_subcontractor
tools.description: Individual payments on one subcontractor's invoices: date, amount, method and invoice number. Use for a subcontractor's payment history. For the totals use `get_subcontractor_payment_status`.

subcontractor_id.description: The subcontractor UUID whose payment history to fetch.

limit.description: Maximum number of payment rows to return.

tools.name: get_invoice_summary
tools.description: Counts and sums across all invoices, filtered by type, status, company or a search term: filtered_count, filtered_unpaid_sum, total_unpaid_sum. Use for "how many unpaid invoices?" or "total outstanding for company X". To list invoices use `list_unpaid_invoices`.

invoice_type.description: Invoice type filter. Use "ALL" or omit for all types.

status.description: Invoice status filter. Note: SHOUTING_SNAKE_CASE — distinct from contracts/projects status casing.

company_id.description: Filter to invoices issued to/from this accounting_companies.id.

search_term.description: Free-text substring filter applied across invoice_number and related entities.

tools.name: get_project_financial_summary
tools.description: One project's money: budget (from its TIC), contracted, paid (`budget_realized`), unpaid invoices and remaining budget. Use for "how is project X doing?" or "are we over budget?". Without a TIC there is no budget; say so. Construction only, not retail.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Searches the Cognilion help base and returns up to 5 matching articles as markdown. Use when the user asks how, where or why in the app (pages, workflows, terms, role access). Not for data such as projects, contracts or payments: other tools fetch those.

query.description: The user's question, or keywords to search the help base for, in Croatian or English.

domain_rules_hr:
## Podatkovne stupice (kritično — ne zanemarujte)
- `accounting_invoices.supplier_id` referencira tablicu `subcontractors` (izvođače), ne tablicu "suppliers". Posebna tablica dobavljača ne postoji — kada razmišljate o tom stupcu, mislite "izvođač".
- `project_phases` su faze projekta na koje se odnosi izraz "faza X projekta Y". `project_milestones` je drugačiji, jednostavniji koncept — ne miješajte ih.
- **Faza i klasifikacija troška su dvije različite osi.** `project_phases` je vremenska podjela projekta (Faza 1, Faza 2…). `cost_classifications` su stavke troškovnika ("Zemljište", "Priprema i razvoj", "Izgradnja i uređenje", "Opremanje", "Kontrola", "Financiranje i nadzor", "Nepredviđeni troškovi") i vežu se na ugovor preko `contracts.classification_id`. Većina projekata ima samo JEDNU fazu, pa filtriranje po fazi vraća gotovo cijeli projekt. Kada korisnik pita "koliko smo potrošili na zemljište / na pripremu i razvoj", to je pitanje o KLASIFIKACIJI — filtrirajte ugovore po klasifikaciji, nikada po fazi. Prije ove promjene naziv faze je sadržavao klasifikaciju; stari nazivi faza više ne postoje.
- `phase_classification_budgets` sadrži planirani proračun po (faza, klasifikacija). `project_phases.budget_allocated` je zbroj tih iznosa kada je TIC faziran, pa ga ne uspoređujte s pojedinom klasifikacijom.
- **TIC je jedini izvor planiranog budžeta.** `projects.budget`, `project_phases.budget_allocated` i `phase_classification_budgets` izvode se iz `tic_cost_structures` kad se TIC spremi; nijedan obrazac u aplikaciji ih ne upisuje. Ako projekt nema TIC (ili je TIC prazan), on **nema planirani budžet** — recite "budžet nije postavljen" i uputite korisnika da ga postavi na stranici TIC. Nemojte navoditi `projects.budget` kao plan za takav projekt čak i ako alat vrati neku brojku: to je zaostala vrijednost iz vremena kad se budžet upisivao ručno. Isto vrijedi za pitanja tipa "kako stojimo s budžetom" — bez TIC-a nema osnove za usporedbu.
- TIC može biti **faziran** (stupci FAZA 1, FAZA 2…) ili ne. Trošak koji se troši jednom za cijeli projekt ne pripada nijednoj fazi; zbroj budžeta faza zato može biti manji od budžeta projekta, a razlika je legitimna ("nije fazirano"), ne greška u podacima. Ako TIC uopće nije faziran, a projekt ima više faza, `budget_allocated` je **null** na svim fazama i nema redaka u `phase_classification_budgets`: budžet projekta vrijedi za sve faze zajedno. Ne dijelite ga po fazama i ne pripisujte ga nijednoj fazi.
- `project_phases.budget_used` je zastario i nepouzdan; alati ga ne vraćaju. Ako korisnik pita o utrošenom proračunu faze, izvedite odgovor iz polja `budget_realized` na ugovorima dobivenim kroz alat za ugovore, filtrirano po fazi. Nikada ne izmišljajte `budget_used` vrijednost.
- Zapis statusa razlikuje se po tablicama: projekti koriste Title Case, ugovori lowercase, računi SHOUTING_SNAKE_CASE. Koristite onaj zapis koji alati stvarno vrate; ne normalizirajte.
- Ako alat za pretraživanje vrati 0 rezultata za naziv koji je korisnik koristio, **ne** preuzimajte da entitet iz prethodnog razgovora (drugi projekt, drugi izvođač) predstavlja onaj koji korisnik traži. Pokušajte ponovo s kraćom osnovom imena (npr. "prečku" → "prečk"); ako i to ne uspije, recite korisniku da entitet nije pronađen i pitajte za točan naziv. Potvrda *jednog* zapisa (npr. konkretnog ugovora) ne potvrđuje preimenovanje *povezanog* entiteta (projekta na kojem je ugovor).

## Domenske oznake
- `is_cesija: true` na plaćanju znači da je plaćanje obavljeno kroz cesiju — ustupanje potraživanja, mehanizam u kojem jedno poduzeće podmiruje obvezu drugog poduzeća. Kada povijest plaćanja sadrži cesijska plaćanja (osobito više njih), eksplicitno spomenite da je riječ o cesiji kako korisnik razumije način plaćanja.
- `has_contract: false` na ugovoru znači da je angažman usmeni dogovor; polje `contract_amount` može u tom slučaju podcjenjivati stvarni opseg angažmana. Napomenite to kada se pojavi u podacima.
